bulkOrder.title: Bulk Order — by Seller
bulkOrder.successHint: Sellers will receive a real-time notification.
bulkOrder.empty: No items selected. Pick low-stock ingredients with a preferred seller mapping first.
bulkOrder.merged: added to your existing draft for this seller
bulkOrder.unlinkedTitle: Needs a supplier link ({{count}}) — not sent

brandSharedHint: Stock item defined by your brand

produce.title: Make
produce.noLines: This recipe has no ingredient lines — add ingredients first.
produce.shortageNote: Some raw ingredients are short. You can still make it, but only what is in stock is recorded as used.
produce.actualYieldHint: Defaults to recipe yield × batches. If the real weight differs, enter it — the cost is calculated on that amount.

prepTagHint: An ingredient you make from a recipe. Stock is added with "Make", not by ordering.

packSize.title: How much stock does one arrive as?
packSize.help: For example — a box of 50 is 50; if it comes as singles, 1.
packSize.poNote: Purchase orders not yet received will use the new value.
packSize.untouchedNote: Current stock and orders already received stay as they are.
packSize.suggest: By the spec on file this is {{n}} — use it

wasteReason.label: Reason
costPanel.uncostedWithStock: {{count}} items in stock have no cost — not counted
costPanel.ingredientsCostedHint: set costs to measure food cost
costPanel.lastStockTakeHint: count monthly for actual food cost
costReport.note: From the stock ledger: actual usage = opening + purchases − closing; theoretical = what the sold menus should have used by recipe. The gap that waste and adjustments do not explain is shown as «unexplained».
costReport.estimatedNote: No stock take at the end of this period — closing stock is estimated from the ledger. Do a month-end stock take for actual cost.
costReport.unknownRows: {{count}} ledger lines have no recorded cost (before costs were kept) — valued at current cost as an estimate.
costReport.empty: No stock movement in this period
costReport.wasteEmpty: No waste recorded in this period
costReport.forbidden: Food cost needs the inventory module and a manager role.
costReport.loadFailed: Could not load the food cost report
costReport.currentRecipeBasis: Based on the current recipe and current costs
stockTakePage.partialHint: Leave all unchecked to count everything.
stockTakePage.completeCountedOnly: Click "Complete Stock Take" — only the items you counted are updated; the rest stay as they are
stockTakePage.completedResult: Stock take completed. Not counted (left unchanged): {{skipped}}. Items that moved while counting (sales etc., adjusted for): {{moved}}.

foresight.title: What to order
foresight.subtitle: An item shows “Order now” when its stock is at or below the reorder number you set for it. No number yet? We estimate one from the last 28 days of use.
foresight.orderNowHint: At or below the reorder number
foresight.noBasisHint: Set a number and we'll tell you when to order
foresight.blockingOn: Stores can't send orders beyond your available stock (blocking is on).
foresight.subtitleBrand: Store orders waiting to ship are taken off first.
foresight.outHintBrand: Nothing left after store orders waiting
foresight.soonLine: {{count}} more will run low within 7 days
foresight.includeSoonModal: Also add {{count}} items that will run low within 7 days

stockSettings.title: Stock settings
stockSettings.appliesTo: Applies to: {{names}} (they share the same stock)
stockSettings.policyTitle: When a store orders more than your available stock
stockSettings.warnHint: The order still comes in. Stores see «Out at brand» when ordering, and your incoming orders show «Stock short». Restock to cover it.
stockSettings.blockHint: Stores can't send an order above what you have left and are asked to reduce the quantity. Turn on only when your stock numbers are accurate (they are estimates until a stock take).
stockSettings.morningOn: Send an app notification each morning
stockSettings.morningHint: Only when items are out or at their reorder point, once a day, to every manager of this brand. No email. To turn it off just for yourself: Notifications › Low Stock Alert.
stockSettings.includeSoon: Include items running low soon in «Add what's needed» by default
stockSettings.perItemHint: Each item's reorder number is set in that item's settings.

reorderAt.autoHint: Estimated from the last 28 days of use. Set your own number in the item settings.

reorderSettings.title: Reorder settings: {{name}}
reorderSettings.level: Reorder when stock is at or below ({{unit}})
reorderSettings.levelHelp: When stock drops to this number the item shows “Order now”. Leave 0 and we estimate it from your usage.
reorderSettings.recommend: You use about {{daily}} {{unit}} a day and delivery takes {{lead}} days — {{suggest}} or more is safer.
reorderSettings.minOrderHelp: Optional. We never suggest less than this.
reorderSettings.autoGroupHelp: Used to estimate a reorder number when you haven't set one, and to work out how much to order.
reorderSettings.manualDaily: Daily use, if history is short ({{unit}}/day)
reorderSettings.brandShared: Name, unit and suppliers are managed by your brand. The numbers below apply to this store only.

gsReorderLevel: Reorder when stock is at or below
